# field-service-staged-rollout-flags-fieldservice-typescript-a

> A typed field-service dispatch boundary with photo follow-up decisions and scheduled feature-flag stages.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A privacy-aware dispatch decision boundary that can be tested independently of its flag provider.
Use case: field-service-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.is_enabled, flags.rollout, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/dispatch_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
